hooks.command: if [ -f docs/code-map/map.json ]; then RC=$(jq -r '.meta.repo_checksum // empty' docs/code-map/map.json); if [ -z "$RC" ] && [ -f docs/code-map/hashes.json ]; then RC=$(jq -r '.repo_checksum // empty' docs/code-map/hashes.json); fi; CTX=$(jq -c --arg rc "$RC" '{meta: ((.meta | {synced_commit, edge_tool, unmapped, shards}) + {repo_checksum: $rc}), flows, invariants, modules, coupling, hotspots}' docs/code-map/map.json); jq -n --arg ctx "$CTX" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: ("Code map (docs/code-map/map.json) — meta/flows/invariants/modules/coupling/hotspots. Sharded layout: file records live in docs/code-map/shards/files.<slug>.json — route by longest prefix via meta.shards, or use docs/code-map/tools/lookup.sh <path>. See the map-code skill.\n" + $ctx)}}'; fi

if [ -f docs/code-map/map.json ]; then MAPPED_CHANGED=$(git status --porcelain -- app/ frontend/src/ 'plugins/*/plugin' 'plugins/*/interface.py' 'plugins/*/cli.py' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); if [ -n "$MAPPED_CHANGED" ]; then QUEUE_NEW=$(git status --porcelain -- docs/code-map/queue/ 2>/dev/null | grep '^??'); if [ -z "$QUEUE_NEW" ]; then FILES_LIST=$(echo "$MAPPED_CHANGED" | tr '\n' ' '); jq -n --arg files "$FILES_LIST" '{decision: "block", reason: ("Mapped source files changed with no changelog-queue entry: " + $files + ". Per the map-code skill'"'"'s same-change rule, append one JSON file to docs/code-map/queue/ describing what changed (schema in the map-code skill) before finishing — this is part of the definition of done.")}'; fi; fi; fi
